description: Compact feed of currently active NasDecode Market Watch catalysts for UI and other apps. Full history is stored in history/market-watch-events.json.

activeEvents.headline: G7/IEA countries confirmed a coordinated emergency oil-product release to counter the geopolitical energy shock.
activeEvents.whyItMatters: Reduces oil-driven inflation pressure and therefore some of the yield/Fed valuation constraint on Nasdaq and semiconductors.

activeEvents.headline: September payrolls sharply missed expectations, reducing near-term Fed-hike expectations and Treasury yields.
activeEvents.whyItMatters: Improves the rate regime for long-duration technology and strengthens the opportunity backdrop if yields remain contained.

activeEvents.headline: Micron reported strong results and guidance with sharply higher contracted AI-memory commitments.
activeEvents.whyItMatters: Strong forward evidence that hyperscalers and AI-system builders are locking in memory supply well into 2027.

activeEvents.headline: Broadcom agreed to provide up to $42B of financing tied to Anthropic AI infrastructure spending.
activeEvents.whyItMatters: Strengthens evidence for custom-AI-silicon demand while highlighting financing-quality risk in the AI capex cycle.
